description: This is a Java service class named BookService that manages book entities within a library management system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and updating books, as well as some external integrations like author and publisher services. The class also supports JSON serialization of all books and contains some unimplemented search methods.

classes.name: BookService
classes.description: A service class for handling business logic related to Book entity management, including CRUD operations, search functionalities, and updates using patch DTOs.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a book by its ID, returns an Optional<Book>.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new book if it has an author and predefined shelf, also associates the book with its author and publishers.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of books in the repository.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of books, or all books matching a filter text.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a book and possibly its author if the author has no other books.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all books and authors from the repository.

methods.name: getJsonRepresentationForBooksAsString
methods.description: Serializes all books into a formatted JSON string with root name 'AllBooks'.

methods.name: findByShelfAndTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Unimplemented method to find books by shelf, title, or author.

methods.name: findByTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Unimplemented method to find books by title or author.

methods.name: findAllBooksByPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Finds all books associated with a particular predefined shelf name.

methods.name: updateBook
methods.description: Updates a book's metadata, author, genres, and shelf based on a DTO, then saves it.
